display_duration.description: Seconds to display before rotating to next plugin (overridden by dynamic duration)

update_interval.description: How often to refresh price data from Yahoo Finance (seconds)

crypto.description: Cryptocurrency symbols in Yahoo Finance format (e.g. BTC-USD)

forex.description: Forex pairs in Yahoo Finance format (e.g. EURUSD=X)

watchlist_file.description: Optional path to a TradingView-style watchlist file (comma-separated EXCH:SYMBOL tokens). When set and readable, it overrides the stocks/crypto/forex arrays. Re-read on every plugin init (so each process restart / Pi boot picks up changes).

show_chart.description: Show mini price chart on each ticker tile

show_logo.description: Show company/crypto logo icon on each tile
